sources: Sundered Prince (batch 4, docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0026_lastrite.md rows E1–E3). Strength and Crit Rate lines on the stat panel. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_claym_0008 passiveEventActions abilityEvent 302 (the wielder deals damage) + CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 2 mask 2097152 (a Final Strike): NotNextCheckAction + CheckMainCharacterCondition (the wielder not controlled) → buff_wpn_claym_0008_atk_up with atk_up; controlled → SimpleCalcBB atk_up_dynamic = atk_up × multi (2, SkillData default) → the same buff with atk_up_dynamic. BuffData buff_wpn_claym_0008_atk_up: attributeType 2 formulaItem 6 (ATK%) +atk_up, `duration`, stackingType 1 priority atk_up (the strongest instance acts). The skill's `buffs` give buff_wpn_claym_0008 for the whole fight (lifeType 1): poiseModifier [CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 2 mask 2097152, CheckMainCharacterCondition] → InstantModifyAttributeForPoise attribute 26 (Stagger efficiency) formulaItem 5 +poise_up. toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01: a template leftover (nothing to write). Values: SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_claym_0008 by skill level.

buffs.label: Sundered Prince: ATK after a Final Strike
buffs.note: The value is taken when it's applied: doubled (multi) if the wielder is controlled then, as the two branches of the abilityEvent-302 handler.

buffs.label: Sundered Prince: Final Strike Stagger
buffs.note: buff_wpn_claym_0008, permanent (lifeType 1): Stagger +poise_up on the wielder's Final Strikes while controlled (batch-4 C3).
